name: Wooden outhouse
description: A plank privy about 1.1 × 1.1 × 2.2 m: a small shed of weathered vertical boards on corner posts and sill beams under a mossy lean-to board roof, with a ledged and braced plank door on iron strap hinges and a crescent moon cut through it near the top.
